# agg_site_event_stream

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.agg_site_event_stream` · dbt area: `growth`

Event stream of website conversion events, for use by tools such as Haus or Eppo to ingest events. Each row is one event with page path hierarchy, conversion category/label, and timestamp. Filtered to only 2025+ to reduce size. Sourced from Google Analytics.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `conversion_label` | The label assigned to the 'Fora Conversion' event in GA >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `event_at` | When the event occured (as a timestamp) >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `event_conversion_category` | The categorized type of event, such as a 'Advisor Lead Conversion' >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `event_key` | A unique identified of the GA event >> SOURCE - Google Analytics data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `event_name` | The name of the event, such as page view or fora conversion >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `page_path` | The full page path (after the hostname) >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `page_path_level_1` | The first element of the path (between the first sets of slashes) >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `page_path_level_2` | The second element of the path (between the first sets of slashes) >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `page_path_level_3` | The third element of the path (between the first sets of slashes) >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `page_path_level_4` | The fourth element of the path (between the first sets of slashes) >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `session_key` | A unique identified of the GA session >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
| `user_pseudo_id` | A unique identifier for the User (website visitor) as identifed by Google >> SOURCE - Google Analytics |
